results.note: Destatis press release of 30 Oct 2026: 'Gross domestic product in the 3rd quarter of 2026 up 0.2% on the previous quarter' (price-, seasonally and calendar-adjusted).
Destatis' first estimate of 30 Oct 2026 puts Q3 2026 GDP at +0.2% on the previous quarter, which is not negative.
Eurostat's preliminary flash estimate for Q3 2026 (30 Oct 2026): seasonally adjusted GDP increased by 0.4% in the euro area compared with the previous quarter.
Eurostat's preliminary flash estimate of 30 Oct 2026 puts euro-area Q3 2026 GDP growth at 0.4% q/q, which is at least 0.2%.
ČSÚ 'Předběžný odhad HDP - 3. čtvrtletí 2026' (050055-26, 30 Oct 2026): GDP grew by 0.5% quarter on quarter (1.6% year on year).
ČSÚ's preliminary estimate of 30 Oct 2026 puts Q3 2026 GDP growth at 0.5% q/q, which is 0.4 or higher.

INSEE's home page key-figure panel shows consumer price inflation (glissement annuel) of +3.4% in October 2026, from the provisional estimate of 30 Oct; the Informations rapides page itself was not opened.
UN meetings coverage of 30 Oct 2026: the Security Council 'unanimously adopted resolution 2833 (2026)' extending the Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 Oct 2027.
UN meetings coverage of 30 Oct 2026: the Security Council 'failed to adopt' both draft resolutions to extend MINURSO, so no extension was adopted in the window.
ExxonMobil's Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, 30 Oct 2026) reports Adjusted Earnings Per Common Share (Non-GAAP) of $4.23, above $4.03.
The BoJ Statement on Monetary Policy of 30 Oct 2026 records an 8-1 vote keeping the call rate at around 1.25%, with Takata Hajime voting against and proposing 1.5%.

The Constitutional Court's news list has only one item dated 29–30 Oct (29 Oct, the hearing schedule for week 45) and none on the interim-measure request in the heads-of-missions case; this rests on the Court's own list, ČTK was not checked.
The MF notice set on 30 Oct 2026 at 14:00 fixes the diesel maximum for 31 Oct–2 Nov at 49.45 CZK/l incl. VAT, below the 49.69 valid on 30 Oct (Cenový věstník 113/2026).

SBS News (1 Nov) reports SNSC secretary Rezaei saying he had read the Vance letter but had not responded, with no date for US–Iran talks; House of Saud (1 Nov) quotes FM Araghchi saying Iran has 'no immediate plans' to meet US officials, and Gulf News's 28–29 Oct liveblog shows only 'reviewing' statements; searches of Reuters/Dawn/Tasnim coverage turned up no named-official answer to the Munir proposal and no announced talks date in the window.

Yakima Herald-Republic (31 Oct) reports only a suit filed on 30 Oct by OneAmerica Votes and others against the Trump administration in W.D. Wash., with no DOJ filing against Washington; CBS News (29 Oct) and IBTimes (30 Oct) likewise report only the DOJ letter and its threat to seek emergency relief, the only DOJ court action being in California.

Deník N (30 Oct, 21:21) reports that Masaryk University will excuse absence from teaching on 3 Nov for students who attend the rally supporting ČT and ČRo, and Brněnský deník says the university leadership decided this on Friday evening (30 Oct); I counted a decision by the rector-led university leadership (vedení), covering the whole university, as the rector announcing excused absence under limb (b), although neither report names the rector personally.

i24NEWS (29 Oct), citing the Central Elections Committee's completed count including double envelopes, gives Likud 27, UTJ 7, Otzma Yehudit 7, Shas 6 and RZP–Zehut 6, a bloc total of 53 (Noam below the threshold), and the Jerusalem Post (29 Oct, updated 22:48) confirms the 53 seats, with no later change reported before 30 Oct 23:59.

Euronews (30 Oct, 12:41) and El Diario Alerta (30 Oct) report that Puente ruled out resigning over the Urda crash and said Sánchez had not asked him to go; his appearance before Congress is still scheduled for 3 Nov, and no cese was announced.

RTÉ (1 Nov) says the Student List 'is yet to nominate a candidate for prime minister' and names only possible contenders (Srdanović, Šoškić, Bodiroga); Kurir (28 Oct) and the anonymously sourced Šoškić reports in Republika/Srpski telegraf likewise show no official naming.

ND+ (30 Oct, citing UOL) reports that STF justices were weighing whether to avoid an immediate reaction and that Moraes had not even authorised the PF searches; Gazeta do Povo (31 Oct, 21:02) mentions only passport and other restrictive measures, with no arrest order.

Il Fatto Quotidiano (29 Oct, 18:33) reports FS confirming normal rail service from 21:00 on 29 Oct to 21:00 on 30 Oct under MIT ordinance 204 T, and coverage on 30 Oct (Progetto Radici, Notizie.it) shows the ordinance still in force, with USB only announcing disobedience; I found no TAR suspension, no revocation and no amendment.

AP via CP24 (30 Oct): evacuees began leaving Oleshky by bus convoy on Friday 30 Oct; Russian ombudswoman Lantratova said the buses also carried residents bound for Russia and Kyiv officials described the Ukraine-bound route via Anapa and Belarus; numbers were not given. Lubinets's own channels were not reached.
